title: The Myth of Time Management
script: (0s-5s) A person sitting at their desk with multiple tabs open on their laptop, scrolling through social media. (5s-10s) Cut to a graph showing how time spent on social media increases over the years. (10s-15s) Voiceover: "We've been taught that managing our time effectively is key to success." (15s-20s) A person trying to fit multiple tasks into their schedule, with a clock ticking in the background. (20s-25s) Voiceover: "But what if we're doing it all wrong?" (25s-30s) Cut to a simple diagram illustrating the Eisenhower Matrix. (30s-35s) Voiceover: "Maybe we're just trying to optimize a flawed system." (35s-40s) A person reflecting on their schedule, with a hint of confusion.
caption: Time management myths. Are you prioritizing tasks based on importance or convenience? Let's challenge the status quo and explore a better way to manage our time. #RationalThoughts #TimeManagement #Productivity
